items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Buck. That's Bill's favorite... [INTERVIEWEE] Trombone? Well, there was a fellow named Morris French.

ctx.x: Yeah. Them days. He's a little help. Well, I didn't know anybody. That's about the only one I heard, you know.
Oh, well, so you know anybody better start with, Buck. That's Bill's favorite, you know. And who did you like trombone?
Trombone? Well, there was a fellow named Morris French.
